en-US.portal.title: Cor-Web Decentralized Panoramic Gateway
en-US.portal.subtitle: Hosted via Corium NNS domain system and DHT distributed object network. Serverless, zero-trust, and tamper-proof, directly powering the ecosystem's full DApp suite.
en-US.portal.intro_text: Cor-Web is the native Web architecture for Corium and Ziokt. Web pages are stored in P2P cryptographically hashed chunks, resolved by NNS and mounted directly to the gateway; all dynamic operations run in dual-tier sandboxes, eliminating XSS and MITM risks.
en-US.portal.footer: Cor-Web • Powered by Corium v108 & Ziokt Engine • NNS Static Site Verified • 2026

en-US.card.forum.title: 💬 Corium Native Distributed Forum
en-US.card.forum.desc: Built on Corium native forum.db and P2P content-addressed store. Topics and replies are Ed25519-signed with live blockchain beacon broadcasts.
en-US.card.fileshare.title: 📦 Distributed FileShare & Streaming
en-US.card.fileshare.desc: Content-addressed object distribution and zero-copy HTTP Range streaming. Generates immutable corium://dht/<hash> references.
en-US.card.onion.title: 🧅 Onion Routing & Noise Tunnel
en-US.card.onion.desc: ETP multi-hop Sphinx layered encryption relay circuits. Assemble 3-hop protective paths with interactive peeling and Noise-IK4 auditing.
en-US.card.zda.title: ⚖️ Ano / ZDA Ternary Formal Logic
en-US.card.zda.desc: Ziokt proprietary three-valued formal algebra (Positive/Negative/Unknown). Tensor Cross collaboration and Merge conflict arbitration.
en-US.card.safefs.title: 🛡️ SafeFS Tamper-Evident Vault
en-US.card.safefs.desc: Client-side AEAD key derivation and cryptographic tamper-evident sealed storage. Confidential document sealing and HMAC verification.
en-US.card.ufsdcpm.title: 🔐 UFS / DCPM Secure Storage Gateway
en-US.card.ufsdcpm.desc: Native zero-knowledge dual plausible-deniability disks and DCPM signed package manager. Active persistent service on 127.0.0.1:8184.
en-US.card.tc16.title: ⚙️ TC-16 Virtual Machine Studio
en-US.card.tc16.desc: Interactive 16-bit microarchitecture code workshop. Write or load TC-16 assembly, inspect R0~R15 registers, Flags, and CPU cycle budgets.
en-US.card.blockchain.title: ⛓️ Blockchain & PoUW Ledger
en-US.card.blockchain.desc: Real-time inspection of chain.db: block heights, hashes, validators, transaction counts, and Proof of Useful Work.
en-US.card.watchat.title: 📨 WATChat End-to-End Chat Bridge
en-US.card.watchat.desc: Decentralized chatroom gateway bridge. Messages safely land in Data Vault with one-click access to standalone WATChat PWA.
en-US.card.sim.title: 🧪 SimManager Cluster Simulation
en-US.card.sim.desc: Cluster node network rehearsal command center. Monitor virtual nodes, consensus voting, and inject Byzantine partition tests.
en-US.card.effort.title: ⛏️ Effort Cross-Chain Coordinator
en-US.card.effort.desc: Multi-chain PoUW difficulty target and useful compute audit board. Coordinate matrix and cryptographic work across chains.
en-US.card.nns.title: 🌐 NNS Domain Registrar & Resolver
en-US.card.nns.desc: Corium decentralized Name Network Service console. Query 25+ registered domains, resolve hashes, and launch target DApps.
en-US.card.board.title: 📝 Community Public Board
en-US.card.board.desc: Community exchange board isolated within Data Vault sandbox. Any browser user can post signed messages persistently.
en-US.card.ecosystem.title: ⚡ Panoramic Ecosystem Matrix
en-US.card.ecosystem.desc: Full-stack architectural topology across Corium, ETP, Ziokt, and Shadow6 protocols, security boundaries, and components.
en-US.card.explorer.title: 📊 Gateway Core Monitoring Console
en-US.card.explorer.desc: Real-time health status, block height, DHT neighbor discovery, sandbox cycle monitoring, and visitor metrics.
en-US.card.mcp.title: 🤖 MCP Agent Tool Console
en-US.card.mcp.desc: Model Context Protocol authenticated tools console. Connect with scoped credentials, inspect tool schemas, and execute operations.
en-US.card.registry.title: ⚖️ Corium Weight Registry
en-US.card.registry.desc: Decentralized node weight registration and validation whitelist management for consensus participants.

zh-CN.portal.badge: COR-WEB 原生去中心化静态门户 • NNS: status / corium
zh-CN.portal.title: Cor-Web 原生去中心化全景门户
zh-CN.portal.subtitle: 本页面通过 Corium NNS 域名系统与 DHT 分布式对象网络托管。无中心化服务器、纯净安全且全网防篡改，直接驱动生态全量 DApp。
zh-CN.portal.intro_text: Cor-Web 是 Corium 与 Ziokt 架构中的原生 Web 体系。网页全部以密码学分块散列形式存储于 P2P 网络，经由 NNS 解析直接挂载到网关；所有动态交互均运行在受控双层沙箱中，消除了跨站脚本 (XSS) 与第三方中间人劫持风险。

zh-CN.card.forum.title: 💬 Corium 原生分布式论坛
zh-CN.card.forum.desc: 基于 Corium 原生 forum.db 与 P2P 内容寻址对象库构建。每条话题与回复均经由 Ed25519 签名与 SHA-256 校验，实时区块链信标广播。
zh-CN.card.fileshare.title: 📦 分布式文件共享与流媒体
zh-CN.card.fileshare.desc: 内容寻址对象分发与零拷贝 HTTP Range 流播放平台。支持上传文本代码分块，生成全局唯一的 corium://dht/<hash> 磁力引用。
zh-CN.card.onion.title: 🧅 洋葱中继 & Noise 隧道
zh-CN.card.onion.desc: ETP 多跳 Sphinx 分层加密中继回路。支持在线组装 3 跳保护链路，模拟逐跳剥皮解密与 Noise-IK4 握手审计。
zh-CN.card.zda.title: ⚖️ Ano / ZDA 三值鉴证
zh-CN.card.zda.desc: Ziokt 独创的三值形式化代数系统（Positive/Negative/Unknown）。提供张量 Cross 协同与 Merge 仲裁求值与公理定理检验。
zh-CN.card.safefs.title: 🛡️ SafeFS 防篡改保险库
zh-CN.card.safefs.desc: 端侧 AEAD 密钥派生与密码学防篡改封存密室。支持私密文档加密存入、HMAC 完整性校验与安全受控读取。
zh-CN.card.ufsdcpm.title: 🔐 UFS / DCPM 安全存储网关
zh-CN.card.ufsdcpm.desc: 原生零知识双重加密磁盘与 DCPM 签名软件包管理器。已在 127.0.0.1:8184 上线持久服务，支持全网安全存储同步。
zh-CN.card.tc16.title: ⚙️ TC-16 虚拟机工坊
zh-CN.card.tc16.desc: 在线 16 位微架构代码工坊。支持自由编写或加载 TC-16 汇编，实时回显 R0~R15 寄存器、Flags 标志与指令周期。
zh-CN.card.blockchain.title: ⛓️ 区块链与 PoUW 账本
zh-CN.card.blockchain.desc: 实时穿透底层 chain.db，展示最新出块高度、区块哈希、验证者身份、交易笔数与有意义算力证明。
zh-CN.card.watchat.title: 📨 WATChat 端到端通讯
zh-CN.card.watchat.desc: 去中心化聊天室网关桥梁。数据安全落入 Data Vault，并可一键拉起独立部署的完整 WATChat PWA 客户端。
zh-CN.card.sim.title: 🧪 SimManager 仿真中心
zh-CN.card.sim.desc: 集群节点网络演练控制中心。观测虚拟节点状态、共识投票，并可注入网络分区演练拜占庭容错机制。
zh-CN.card.effort.title: ⛏️ Effort 多链算力协调
zh-CN.card.effort.desc: 多链 PoUW 难度目标与有意义工作量审核大盘。维护矩阵运算、同态加密等可信算力任务的跨链最终性。
zh-CN.card.nns.title: 🌐 NNS 域名注册与管理
zh-CN.card.nns.desc: Corium 域名系统控制台。实时查询全网 25+ 已注册应用域名，输入任意域名即可解析目标哈希并直达 DApp。
zh-CN.card.board.title: 📝 社区公网留言板
zh-CN.card.board.desc: 基于 Data Vault 沙箱隔离持久化的社区动态交流板。任何浏览器用户均可签名发布留言并实时留存。
zh-CN.card.ecosystem.title: ⚡ 全景生态大盘
zh-CN.card.ecosystem.desc: 全方位汇总展示 Corium、ETP、Ziokt 与 Shadow6 的协议规范、安全边界与技术组件交互拓扑图。
zh-CN.card.explorer.title: 📊 网关核心监控控制台
zh-CN.card.explorer.desc: 网关实时健康状态、出块高度、DHT 邻居节点健康探测、沙箱指令周期监控与访问计数统计总控台。
zh-CN.card.mcp.title: 🤖 MCP 智能体工具控制台
zh-CN.card.mcp.desc: Model Context Protocol 原生授权控制台。支持端侧 OAuth2 PKCE 认证，自动发现组件工具与沙箱写入审查执行。
zh-CN.card.registry.title: ⚖️ Corium 权重白名单
zh-CN.card.registry.desc: 去中心化节点权重注册表与共识验证者准入白名单，支持在线登记并与区块链节点保持同步验证。
